answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 61366 Country: India Title: for wadu Question: Will wudhu be completed in the bleached position on the face because in bleaching the hairs of face turn dye? Answer ID: 61366 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 876/841/SN=12/1436) Wudhu shall be valid if water reaches up to the skin, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
